image_description: A close-up, low-angle shot of an illuminated pedestrian traffic signal. The signal displays a 'Walk' icon (a walking person) composed of LED dots in yellow and green, with a red 'Don't Walk' hand icon partially visible to the left. The housing is dark gray/black with a large visor extending over the lens. The background is dark and out of focus, suggesting an urban night setting.
